eligibility_evidence: Job Objective Support and optimize international roaming technical operations by managing roaming configurations, conducting network testing, troubleshooting signaling and connectivity issues, and ensuring reliable roaming services across international mobile network operators.
Main Tasks Manage and support international roaming technical operations across 4G/LTE, 5G, VoLTE, and data roaming services.
Perform roaming configuration, network integration, testing, and troubleshooting with international mobile network operators.
Manage and troubleshoot IPX and GRX connectivity to ensure reliable international roaming interconnection.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: The role requires strong hands-on technical expertise and the ability to perform network diagnostics, testing, configuration, and technical support remotely through secure access to network systems. Conduct IREG and TADIG testing to validate roaming connectivity, service functionality, and compliance with technical requirements. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field. Significant hands-on experience in international roaming technical operations, preferably with a mobile network operator. Demonstrated expertise in network troubleshooting, signaling analysis, remote diagnostics, and performance optimization.
